node.title: PMA B11 exact first-match router: Johnson and two anchor gates
node.statement: For fixed E,V_2,V_R, maximal-sunflower extras partition disjointly into GROW, J, A2, AR, and RES. The J/A2/AR union has the exact B11 Johnson plus two-petal-anchor plus background-petal-anchor bound; only GROW and RES remain.
